scope: Fixed L120 IBBI and E-token ROI pilot; zero training updates.

inference.random_process: Original full image-ID-derived generator, including VAE initialization and scheduler draws
inference.dtype: float32, existing TF32/backend and original VAE decode autocast

mapping.threshold: >0.5 for each raw NSD Subject1 functional label; padding excluded; no pre-union
mapping.space: Official NSD native white -> fsaverage nearest-neighbor 1-based source index transform, each hemisphere separately
mapping.conflicts: Retain all memberships; within-group union deduplicated; no outcome-based changes
mapping.matched: Parcel count and hemisphere counts only
mapping.unmatched: SNR, effective vertices, functional membership, spatial adjacency

attention.source: Existing IPAttnProcessor2_0.ip_attn_map read-only post-forward hooks; original decoder loop unchanged
attention.conditional_identity: Assert actual UNet encoder row0 tail equals actual unconditional projected E=0, row1 equals actual conditional projected E
attention.validation: finite/nonnegative/query parcel mass1, dimension200, actual Transformer2DModel input H/W; CPU/CUDA RNG state unchanged by capture
attention.B: Original integrate_attention_layers, mean heads then query-weighted layers
attention.RAM: Original create_roi_attention_map per layer, ROI/head mean, bilinear512, L1 per layer, equal-layer mean; time mean after per-step normalization
attention.display: Original create_attention_overlay display contrast only; quantitative arrays retained

intervention.operation: Clone conditional E, zero selected rows, assert others bitwise unchanged, retain all200 rows and original unconditional branch
intervention.limit: Projection bias/LayerNorm remain; zero E is not token removal or complete K/V path removal; not a verified Table14 exact implementation

checks.identity_and_empty_mask: Same original2 x2 trajectories with attention hooks and explicit empty mask must match original L120 pixel-exact; reused in64
checks.all_ibbi: All64 candidates must also match original baseline pixel-exact

scores.author_evaluator: scripts/evaluate_stage.py metrics unchanged; each candidate scored in100 pool then averaged
scores.E: D_ROI - mean of three same-size random D

bootstrap.implementation: Same batched image-paired percentile loop as existing complete_l130_val500.py

interpretation: Repeated internal development set, fixed model and masks, descriptive nominal intervals, no historical-selection correction, no independent test, no human brain causality. No requirement for significance.
stop: Complete bounded results, fixed atlases, attention arrays/maps and Chinese report, then stop. No additional conditions, training or checkpoints.
